exposure: time provided to sign the IC
cohort: The study included 156 hospitalized female patients who had undergone obstetric or gynaecological surgeries.
finding: Most patients (over 85%) were satisfied with their surgical informed consent experience, with the person-in-charge of SIC administration and time provided to sign the IC being significant predictors of satisfaction.
mod_finding: The most performed surgery in the cohort was caesarean section (84%).
